function.description: API to retrieve the maintenance schedule information for the given id.
function.name: api_retrievesTheMaintenanceScheduleInformation

id.description: Unique identifier for the maintenance schedule

description.description: A brief narrative describing the maintenance schedule.

id.description: Id of the schedule maintenance window

maintenanceSchedule.description: Contains all the details necessary to define the maintenance window and its recurrence.

endId.description: Activity id of end schedule of the maintenance window. To check the status of the end schedule, use GET /intent/api/v1/activities/{id}. endId remains same for every occurrence of recurrence instance.

endTime.description: End time indicates the ending of the maintenance window in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

recurrence.description: Details about the recurrence of the maintenance schedule

interval.description: Interval for recurrence in days. The interval must be longer than the duration of the schedules. The maximum allowed interval is 365 days.

recurrenceEndTime.description: The end date for the recurrence in Unix epoch time in milliseconds. Recurrence end time should be greater than maintenance end date/time.

startId.description: Activity id of start schedule of the maintenance window. To check the status of the start schedule, use GET /intent/api/v1/activities/{id}. startId remains same for every occurrence of recurrence instance.

startTime.description: Start time indicates the beginning of the maintenance window in Unix epoch time in milliseconds.

status.description: The status of the maintenance schedule.

networkDeviceIds.description: List of network device ids. This field is applicable only during creation of schedules; for updates, it is read-only.
